tei:div.tei:p: khyab bdag dang po'i mgon po kun tu bzang*// bde stong dbyer med dpal ldan rdo rje sems// rgyal tshab ston pa dga' rab rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// zung 'jug mthar phyin shrī siṃ ha'i zhabs// gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang*// zab lam snying po'i don gzigs bi ma lar// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun dngos padma 'byung*// mkha' spyod dbang mo ye shes mtsho rgyal dang*// nges don lam bzang gsal mdzad bai ro rjer// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// snga 'gyur bstan pa'i nyi ma gter bdag gling*// bi ma'i rnam 'phrul rin chen rnam par rgyal// rig 'dzin sa brnyes padma bstan 'dzin la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// nges gsang lam ston phrin las rnam par rgyal// mchog gzigs padma dbang rgyal lcam dral zung*// gtsug lag chos rgyal 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gter// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// smin grol 'dod dgu'i mchog stsol bla ma rje// bde chen sgyu ma'i rnam rol yi dam lha// phrin las thogs med mkha' 'gro chos skyong la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// 'dis thob dge bas bdag gzhan mkha' mnyam 'gro /byang chub sems 'byongs gang snang lha skur shar/ khregs chod lta ba mthar phyin thod rgal gyi// 'pho med zab lam mtha' ru phyin par shog /
ces mdo khams go 'jo bla ma shes rab 'od zer dang bsod nams phun tshogs gnyis kyis bskul ngor 'gyur med rdo rjes bris pa'o// //
